card.name: Linking words after time or distance spans
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, from, following, by) that come right after a time span, distance or sequence word and introduce the reference point. Also "by" after Preceded/Followed in book infoboxes.

modes.label: Span then reference
modes.description: "of", "from" or "following" after an amount of time or distance, naming what it is measured against.
